drivingQuestion: Is a stain exactly the size of a split bean within 'up to a split bean'?
outcomeNote: dispute recorded; analyzed in the next unit

segments.he: עַד כַּמָּה הִיא תּוֹלָה וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַב הוּנָא: כִּגְרִיס — אֵינָהּ תּוֹלָה, פָּחוֹת מִכִּגְרִיס — תּוֹלָה, וְרַב חִסְדָּא אָמַר: כִּגְרִיס — תּוֹלָה, יָתֵר מִכִּגְרִיס — אֵינָהּ תּוֹלָה.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «How large» a stain may a woman «attribute» to a louse? Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus says: It can be up to the area of a split bean. The Gemara notes that the meaning of the statement of Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus is a matter of dispute among the Sages. «Rav Huna says:» If the stain was the size «of a split bean she may not attribute» it to the blood of a louse; if it was «less than» the size «of a split bean she may attribute» it to the blood of a louse. «And Rav Ḥisda says:» Even if it was the size «of a split bean she may» still «attribute» it to the blood of a louse; but if the stain was «more than» the size «of a split bean she may not attribute» it to the blood of a louse.
